Q1_narrow_projection.rationale: Sum revenue over one column. Tests columnar projection: a row store must read every field, a column store reads one.

bench_raw_json.label: raw JSON, uncompressed, unpartitioned
bench_raw_json.sql: SELECT SUM(gross_amount) AS total_revenue FROM bench_raw_json

bench_parquet_flat.label: Parquet + Snappy, unpartitioned
bench_parquet_flat.sql: SELECT SUM(gross_amount) AS total_revenue FROM bench_parquet_flat

bench_parquet_part.label: Parquet + Snappy, partitioned by event_date
bench_parquet_part.sql: SELECT SUM(gross_amount) AS total_revenue FROM bench_parquet_part

Q2_date_filtered_aggregate.rationale: Aggregate a single day. Tests partition pruning: only the partitioned variant can skip the other days entirely.

bench_raw_json.label: raw JSON, uncompressed, unpartitioned
bench_raw_json.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(gross_amount) AS revenue FROM bench_raw_json WHERE event_date = '2026-07-31' GROUP BY event_type

bench_parquet_flat.label: Parquet + Snappy, unpartitioned
bench_parquet_flat.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(gross_amount) AS revenue FROM bench_parquet_flat WHERE event_date = '2026-07-31' GROUP BY event_type

bench_parquet_part.label: Parquet + Snappy, partitioned by event_date
bench_parquet_part.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(gross_amount) AS revenue FROM bench_parquet_part WHERE event_date = '2026-07-31' GROUP BY event_type

Q3_full_scan_groupby.rationale: Group the whole table by type. No pruning is possible, so this isolates the effect of compression and encoding alone.

bench_raw_json.label: raw JSON, uncompressed, unpartitioned
bench_raw_json.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM bench_raw_json GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY n DESC

bench_parquet_flat.label: Parquet + Snappy, unpartitioned
bench_parquet_flat.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM bench_parquet_flat GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY n DESC

bench_parquet_part.label: Parquet + Snappy, partitioned by event_date
bench_parquet_part.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM bench_parquet_part GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY n DESC
